content: Considering your friend's current shirt colors, which are all in the red family, they might have a preference for similar shades. Crimson is another shade of red, so it could align with their existing color choices. If you want to diversify their wardrobe, white or blue could also be good options, providing a classic or contrasting addition to their collection. Ultimately, the choice depends on whether you want to stick with what seems to be their preferred color scheme or introduce something different.
